title: Pakistan, Taliban Exchange Fire in Paktika and South Waziristan; One Civilian Killed
detail: On October 27, 2026, Pakistani and Taliban forces exchanged fire in Paktika and Lower South Waziristan; residents reported heavy weapons. Pakistani authorities said a mortar hit a family home, killing one civilian and wounding five. The Taliban Ministry of Defense said Pakistani drones hit security facilities in Paktika and that it retaliated against Pakistani positions, claiming unspecified Pakistani losses and none of its own. Pakistan called that account a fabrication and said Taliban forces fired first. Casualty claims are not independently verified.

media.caption: Clashes along the Afghan-Pakistan border, Oct 27
